environment_identity: A synthetic, non-identifiable representative Greater Sacramento residential lot; never a real parcel or completed project.
closed_world_rule: A constituent is admitted only when it matches one entry in admitted_constituent_classes and the join manifest proves its required origin and digest fields. Anything else is refused.

admitted_constituent_classes.origin: Only the three OWNED A600 records in p2-hero-source-ledger-v1.json.
admitted_constituent_classes.generation: Deterministic geometry derived from the admitted q16/profile records; no substituted or inferred construction assemblies.

admitted_constituent_classes.origin: Authored by packet-owned code from Blender primitives or geometry generated wholly by that code.
admitted_constituent_classes.generation: No imported mesh, curve, point cloud, scan, plan, GIS data, photograph, vegetation pack, or copied identifiable property/design.

admitted_constituent_classes.origin: Blender node graphs and constant values authored by packet-owned code.
admitted_constituent_classes.generation: No image texture, scanned material, downloaded node group, manufacturer media, or externally sourced colorimetry.

admitted_constituent_classes.origin: Blender procedural sun, sky, world nodes, and constant values authored by packet-owned code.
admitted_constituent_classes.generation: No HDRI, sky photograph, environment map, or downloaded lighting rig.

absolute_refusals: external or third-party mesh, geometry library, vegetation pack, scan, point cloud, CAD, GIS, survey, or plan
downloaded or scanned texture, image texture, material library, manufacturer media, or physical sample claim
HDRI, environment map, sky photograph, stock media, photography, video, font, icon pack, or template
Adobe property-stage composite or any Adobe composite constituent
ImageGen, generative image, generative fill, generative extension, or generated raster as a source
purchase, paid license, trial asset, scraped asset, unattributed source, or source with unknown rights
copied identifiable house, landscape, parcel, client property, or authored third-party design

manifest_contract.scope: Every generated source file and every returned artifact, including .blend, still, contact sheet, animation, and manifest.
manifest_contract.rule: Missing, null, malformed, duplicate, unknown, or unverifiable constituent evidence fails closed. Artifact digests do not legalize a refused source.

join_checks.pass: Manifest identifies Issue #327 and binds the inspected scene script and all generated files to one exact head SHA.
Every generator path is repository-owned and declared; no executable, add-on, linked library, appended external blend, or undeclared helper is used.
A600 geometry cites only the three admitted OWNED ledger records and preserves their concept-only limits.
Lot, existing house, hardscape, landscape, fence cues, and props are generated from Blender primitives or packet-owned generated geometry.
Every material is a declared procedural node graph; the scene and manifest contain zero image textures or external material libraries.
Lighting uses only declared procedural sun/sky/world; the scene and manifest contain zero HDRI or environment-image dependency.
Manifest and scene inspection find zero external mesh, texture, HDRI, stock, font, photography, Adobe composite, ImageGen, manufacturer media, purchase, or unknown-rights dependency.
The returned .blend reports no missing files, linked libraries, unresolved paths, or network-loaded constituent; reopening it does not fetch external content.
Every generated source file and returned artifact has a recomputed matching SHA-256; duplicates and omissions fail.

Responsive evidence preserves the shot contract and exact conceptual representative-property disclosure without parcel, feasibility, permit, completed-project, material-sample, or construction-readiness claim.

join_decision.fail: BLOCKED — name the first failed join check and exact missing or refused evidence
join_decision.authority: This policy clears source admissibility only. It does not approve a visual, merge, deployment, Production use, spend, or public claim.

required_disclosure: Conceptual A600 visualization on a representative property — not a completed project, parcel-specific fit, approved plan, permit, price, schedule, or buildability conclusion.
